name: robotics-spatial-vision-mcp
description: Point cloud ICP alignment, Recast navmesh baking, robot arm inverse kinematics, and LIDAR ground plane filtering for physical AI agents.

PAYMENT_WALLET.description: Base L2 EVM payout wallet address to receive USDC micropayments

tools.name: pointcloud_icp_rigid_registration
tools.description: Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm aligning two unorganized 3D point clouds with robust Tukey loss weighting to filter noisy scan outliers. (0.045 USDC on Base L2)

tools.name: navmesh_recast_baking_validator
tools.description: Generates and audits Recast 3D navigation meshes for autonomous agents, checking maximum slope climbing, step-height clearance, and unreachable islands. (0.040 USDC on Base L2)

tools.name: robot_arm_inverse_kinematics_ccd
tools.description: Cyclic Coordinate Descent (CCD) and FABRIK solver computing 6-DOF robotic manipulator joint angles with strict joint-angle limit enforcement. (0.040 USDC on Base L2)

tools.name: lidar_ground_plane_ransac_filter
tools.description: RANSAC plane segmentation isolating ground terrain from foreground obstacles and vehicles in dense unorganized LIDAR point clouds. (0.035 USDC on Base L2)

tools.name: camera_intrinsics_projection_matrix
tools.description: Computes 4x4 perspective and orthographic camera projection matrices, mapping FOV, focal length, sensor dimensions, and near/far clipping planes. (0.020 USDC on Base L2)
